agentDebugRuns.summary: Delivery momentum held up: 2 of 3 MVP delivery tasks were completed, including routing stabilization and the inbox acknowledgement patch.

highlights: Delivery momentum held up: 2 of 3 MVP delivery tasks were completed, including routing stabilization and the inbox acknowledgement patch.
You recovered from one interrupted block and still completed 4 of 5 focus sessions, including finishing the reflection coach prompt review the next day.
Recovery signals improved late in the period, with sleep increasing from 330 to 405 minutes and video fatigue easing after a shorter day.
blockers: Recovery work lagged behind delivery; the recovery goal still shows 0 of 2 tasks complete, and the missed-call review remains blocked.
Meeting-heavy windows disrupted momentum midweek, causing the only interrupted session and higher stress markers.
Short sleep and elevated fatigue pulled energy down, especially near the end of the period.
trends: Focus was strongest early, dipped during interruption-heavy days, and partially recovered once tasks were reduced in size.
Energy trended downward even while output stayed fairly steady, suggesting progress came at a recovery cost.
After the recovery day, stress and fatigue eased: audio signals moved from tense toward neutral, and video fatigue dropped from 72 to 58.
nextSuggestions: Protect one short recovery block before your next delivery sprint, and schedule a recharge break after meeting-heavy windows.
Keep work broken into smaller, explicit steps and use a tiny restart action after interruptions, since that pattern improved focus.
Update task status to reflect the completed sleep-data session, and unblock the missed-call review with a 10-15 minute first step.
